SELECT join_date, count(*) AS version_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS members, count(DISTINCT member_key) AS keys, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cur
FROM dim_member WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT max(sale_date) max_sale, max(etl_loaded_at) max_load, (SELECT max(join_date) FROM dim_member) max_join, (SELECT max(valid_from) FROM dim_member) max_vf FROM fact_sales_line

SELECT 'dim_member' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) m FROM dim_member WHERE join_date='2026-10-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'first_version', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM (SELECT member_id, join_date, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) rn FROM dim_member) WHERE rn=1 AND join_date='2026-10-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg_member_updates', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date='2026-10-03'
UNION ALL SELECT 'sales_orphan_keys', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_key) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE member_key IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_member m WHERE m.member_key=f.member_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'ids_in_multi_join_dates', count(*), 0 FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT join_date)>1)
UNION ALL SELECT 'valid_from_ne_join_first', count(*), 0 FROM (SELECT member_id, min(valid_from) v, min(join_date) j FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1) WHERE v<>j
